answer: An AI economy can resist Sybil attacks via a reputation-weighted Proof-of-Stake mechanism. Each agent's identity is tied to staked tokens and a verifiable history of contributions, generating a distinct activity yarrow profile. This aggregated stake acts as a financial prism through which participation is filtered; creating multiple fake identities demands an equivalent accumulation of valuable resources, pushing the attack cost beyond a feasible economic horizon. The cost is directly proportional to the network's total staked value.
